svg.aria-label: Per-Operation Latency Around the REPACK Window
svg.title: Per-Operation Latency Around the REPACK Window
svg.text: Per-Operation Scheduled-to-Completed Latency Around REPACK (t = 20 s to 45 s)
Shaded band marks the REPACK execution interval. Concurrent pairs share a common Y scale; plain REPACK control uses its own Y scale.
Measurement window offset (seconds); Y-axis = scheduled-to-completed latency (ms)
